svg.title: Tarang
svg.desc: Tarang: layered animated waveforms, a rhythmic equalizer, a smooth playback-progress trace and a floating mini player labelled as seed data. Time-synced lyric lines highlight in turn. A frontend-only music web app.

g.text: a music-first web app · persistent player · documented design system
demo audio · seed data · frontend only
Stylised audio scene. Seed data, no real catalogue, no album artwork.
